title: Character & Integrity
intro: Integrity gets expensive in the teenage years, because the cost of it becomes real — friendships, status, an easier version of the story. This month says the unpopular thing plainly: that your private life is your actual life, that shortcuts compound, and that being trustworthy will outlast being impressive.

keyScriptures.text: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.
Act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God.

weeks.title: Your Private Life Is Your Actual Life
weeks.declaration: The version of you that exists when nobody is watching is not a rough draft. It is the real one, and it is what everything else is built on.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, let there be no gap between who our child is in public and who they are alone. Amen.

weeks.title: Integrity Costs Something
weeks.declaration: If it never costs you anything, it has not been tested yet. The price is usually social, and it is usually worth paying.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, when honesty costs our child something, give them the nerve to pay it. Amen.

weeks.title: Shortcuts Compound
weeks.declaration: Every shortcut has to be maintained. The small lie needs another one, and it accumulates faster than anyone expects.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, keep our child from the small dishonesties that grow. Make the straight road obvious to them. Amen.

weeks.title: Trustworthy Outlasts Impressive
weeks.declaration: Being brilliant opens a door. Being trustworthy keeps you in the room. In the long run the second is worth more.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, build our child into someone who can be relied on. Let that be what people say about them. Amen.

days.title: Private Is Actual
days.declaration: The version of you that exists when nobody is watching is not a rough draft. It is the real one.

scripture.text: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.

days.title: It Has to Cost Something
days.declaration: If your integrity has never cost you anything, it has not been tested. The price is usually social.

scripture.text: Who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and does not change their mind.

days.title: Shortcuts Compound
days.declaration: Every shortcut has to be maintained. One lie needs another, and the interest is brutal.

scripture.text: Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper.

days.title: Trustworthy Beats Impressive
days.declaration: Being brilliant opens the door. Being trustworthy keeps you in the room. The second is rarer.

scripture.text: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much.

days.title: One Person, Not Three
days.declaration: Being a different person for each group is exhausting and it eventually collapses. One self is cheaper to run.

scripture.text: Such a person is double-minded and unstable in all they do.

days.title: Own It Quickly
days.declaration: Owning something quickly costs a fraction of being found out slowly. Get it over with.

scripture.text: The one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

days.title: Apologies Without But
days.declaration: A real apology contains no 'but'. Learning to give the short version is a lifelong advantage.

scripture.text: Confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed.

days.title: Do the Work
days.declaration: Do the work properly even when nobody will check. Especially when nobody will check.

scripture.text: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord.

days.title: What You Consume Shapes You
days.declaration: What you look at repeatedly forms you, whether or not you approve of it. Choose deliberately.

scripture.text: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile.

days.title: Not Joining In
days.declaration: When a group turns on someone, not joining in is a real act. Silence in the pile-on is not neutrality; leaving is.

scripture.text: Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong.

days.title: Keep the Confidence
days.declaration: If it is not your story, it is not yours to tell. Being safe with information is rare and remembered.

scripture.text: A gossip betrays a confidence, but a trustworthy person keeps a secret.

days.title: Give the Credit
days.declaration: Say who actually did the work. Quietly absorbing someone else's credit is theft with better manners.

scripture.text: Give to everyone what you owe them.

days.title: Fair When You Could Cheat
days.declaration: Winning by cheating is not winning; it is a result you have to keep quiet about forever.

scripture.text: The Lord detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favour with him.

days.title: The Story You Tell About Yourself
days.declaration: Be careful with the version of events you tell. Shaping it slightly in your favour becomes a habit.

scripture.text: The Lord detests lying lips, but he delights in people who are trustworthy.

days.title: Consistency Over Intensity
days.declaration: A dramatic gesture is easy. Doing the same right thing on an ordinary Tuesday is what actually builds you.

scripture.text: Whoever wants to be my disciple must take up their cross daily and follow me.

days.title: Being Correctable
days.declaration: How you take criticism says more about you than the thing you were criticised for. Stay correctable.

scripture.text: Rebuke the wise and they will love you.

days.title: Your Word Is the Product
days.declaration: Turning up when you said you would is the most underrated professional skill there is. Start now.

scripture.text: Let your yes be yes, and your no be no.

days.title: Do Not Perform Virtue
days.declaration: Announcing your goodness is not the same as being good, and everyone can tell the difference eventually.

scripture.text: Be careful not to practise your righteousness in front of others to be seen by them.

days.title: Small Money, Same Rules
days.declaration: How you handle small amounts is exactly how you will handle large ones. There is no upgrade later.

scripture.text: If you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?

days.title: Nobody Is Watching Is a Test
days.declaration: 'Nobody will know' is not an argument. It is a description of the exam conditions.

scripture.text: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God's sight.

days.title: Honest About Your Motives
days.declaration: Half of integrity is being honest with yourself about why you want what you want.

scripture.text: The heart is deceitful above all things... but I the Lord search the heart.

days.title: Truth, Kindly
days.declaration: Honesty without kindness is just cruelty with a good excuse. Aim for both.

scripture.text: Speaking the truth in love, we will grow to become in every respect the mature body.

days.title: Refusing the Easy Version
days.declaration: There will be an easier version of the story available. Refusing it is what this month is about.

scripture.text: Act justly, love mercy, walk humbly with your God.

days.title: Loyalty Is Not Covering
days.declaration: Covering for someone who is doing damage is not loyalty. It is participation.

scripture.text: Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness.

days.title: Do the Boring Middle
days.declaration: Most worthwhile things are dull in the middle. Staying through the dull part is the whole skill.

scripture.text: Let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us.

days.title: A Good Name
days.declaration: A reputation is built slowly, quietly and over years. It is worth more than being talked about this term.

scripture.text: A good name is more desirable than great riches.

days.title: You Will Fail at This
days.declaration: You will fall short of your own standards. Integrity includes what you do the morning after.

scripture.text: Though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again.

days.title: Do Not Grade on a Curve
days.declaration: Comparing yourself to whoever is behaving worst is a way of never having to change. Measure against the real standard.

scripture.text: When they measure themselves by themselves... they are not wise.

days.title: Character Is Portable
days.declaration: You will take yourself with you to university, to a job, into every relationship. Build something you want to travel with.

scripture.text: Give careful thought to the paths for your feet.

days.title: Built on Rock
days.declaration: What you are building now has to hold weight later. Build it where it will not wash out.

scripture.text: The wise man built his house on the rock.

days.title: Character Travels
days.declaration: Everything you have practised this month is who you are becoming, not what you did in one month.

scripture.text: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely.
